items.front: Gupta ruler order (founder to great line)?
items.back: Sri Gupta → Ghatotkacha → Chandragupta I → Samudragupta → Chandragupta II → Kumaragupta I → Skandagupta.
items.examPoint: Rise of the Guptas — feudatories, chronology & economic base
items.source: APPSC GK — Gupta Empire

items.front: Founders' title vs Chandragupta I's title?
items.back: Sri Gupta & Ghatotkacha = 'Maharaja'; Chandragupta I = 'Maharajadhiraja' (first true emperor).
items.examPoint: Chandragupta I — Maharajadhiraja & Lichchhavi/Kumaradevi alliance
items.source: APPSC GK — Gupta Empire

items.front: Chandragupta I's key alliance and its coin?
items.back: Married Lichchhavi princess Kumaradevi (clan at Vaishali); commemorated on King-and-Queen gold coins.
items.examPoint: Lichchhavi clan headquartered at Vaishali
items.source: APPSC GK — Gupta Empire

items.front: Why is Samudragupta the 'Napoleon of India'; his other title?
items.back: V.A. Smith's name for his conquests (blood-and-iron, Ashvamedha); also 'Kaviraja' — coins show him playing the veena.
items.examPoint: Samudragupta — 'Napoleon of India', Kaviraja, blood-and-iron, Ashvamedha
items.source: APPSC GK — Gupta Empire

items.front: Prayag/Allahabad Prashasti — composer & subject?
items.back: Composed by Harishena (Samudragupta's courtier); a eulogy of Samudragupta's conquests, on an Ashokan pillar.
items.examPoint: Allahabad/Prayag Prashasti by Harishena
items.source: APPSC GK — Gupta Empire

items.front: Chandragupta II Vikramaditya — his big military win & foreign visitor?
items.back: Defeated the Western Kshatrapas (Shakas), won Malwa/Gujarat; Chinese pilgrim Fa-Hien visited in his reign.
items.examPoint: Chandragupta II Vikramaditya — titles, defeat of Shakas & empire extent
items.source: APPSC GK — Gupta Empire

items.front: Fa-Hien's account of Gupta society?
items.back: Peaceful, prosperous, law-abiding, largely vegetarian; mild punishments; no spy system; poor treatment of outcastes.
items.examPoint: Fa-Hien — visit & account of Gupta society
items.source: APPSC GK — Gupta Empire

items.front: Navaratnas — the star, and match authors to works?
items.back: Kalidasa (Shakuntalam, Meghaduta). Vishakhadatta–Mudrarakshasa & Devichandraguptam; Shudraka–Mrichchhakatika; Amarasimha–Amarakosha.
items.examPoint: Author-work pairs — Vishakhadatta (Devichandraguptam), Varahamihira (Brihat Samhita)
items.source: NCERT; APPSC GK — Gupta Empire

items.front: Mehrauli Iron Pillar — whose inscription; who moved it?
items.back: Chandragupta II (Vikramaditya, 'Chandra'); rust-resistant; later moved to Delhi by Firoz Shah Tughlaq.
items.examPoint: Mehrauli Iron Pillar (Chandragupta II; moved by Firoz Shah Tughlaq)
items.source: APPSC GK — Gupta Empire

items.front: Kumaragupta I — his university and title?
items.back: Founded Nalanda Mahavihara; titles Shakraditya/Mahendraditya; Ashvamedha; peacock coins. (Bhitari pillar = Skandagupta.)
items.examPoint: Kumaragupta I — titles, Nalanda, Bhitari pillar, Ashvamedha
items.source: APPSC GK — Gupta Empire

items.front: Skandagupta — two things he is remembered for?
items.back: Resisted the earliest Huna invasions; repaired the Sudarshana Lake (Junagadh). Last strong Gupta ruler.
items.examPoint: Skandagupta — Sudarshan Lake & resistance to the Hunas
items.source: APPSC GK — Gupta Empire

items.front: Aryabhata's key contributions?
items.back: Concept of zero & the decimal place-value system; stated the earth rotates on its own axis (not that it revolves round the Sun); work = Aryabhatiya.
items.examPoint: Aryabhata — zero, decimal & heliocentric idea
items.source: APPSC GK — Gupta Empire

items.front: Varahamihira's works?
items.back: Panchasiddhantika (505 CE, five siddhantas incl. Romaka=Roman/Greek) and Brihat Samhita; a Navaratna.
items.examPoint: Varahamihira — Panchasiddhantika & Romaka Siddhanta
items.source: APPSC GK — Gupta Empire

items.front: Gupta provincial hierarchy and gold coin name?
items.back: Bhukti (province, under Uparika) → Vishaya (district, Vishayapati) → Vithi → Grama. Gold coins = Dinaras.
items.examPoint: Gupta provincial administration (Bhukti/Vishaya/Vithi; cash salaries)
items.source: APPSC GK — Gupta Empire

items.front: Which north-west invaders caused Gupta decline; first Nagara temple?
items.back: The Hunas (Mihirakula); Dashavatara temple at Deogarh is an early Nagara-style Gupta temple. Last ruler = Vishnugupta.
items.examPoint: Decline of the Guptas & successor states
items.source: APPSC GK — Gupta Empire

items.front: On the ruins of which two empires did the Guptas rise?
items.back: The Kushanas (north) and the Satavahanas (Deccan).
